as_told.title: Rumours that Hughes's Glomar Explorer recovered objects from the seafloor

plain: The Glomar Explorer, a huge deep-sea ship built in 1974 for Howard Hughes's company, may have had a second, hidden job, Michels suggests. In one episode he only wonders aloud about it. In another he says outright that there are rumours it was used to find and bring up strange objects from the seafloor, which would mean UFO recovery had been run under cover of a big private company.
